EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome to Intel® Partner Alliance Gold
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Intel® Partner Alliance Gold
{!Contact.FirstName},
We have made some exciting changes and have modified the Intel® Partner Alliance program criteria and enhanced the benefits that support your business needs. As a result, your company has been upgraded to Intel Partner Alliance Gold. Congratulations!
Here are some incremental benefits you will receive as Gold tier member:
Gold Badge Advanced Warranty Replacement More points earning and redeeming opportunities Access to Solutions Marketplace storefront & posting Access to Developer Zone - Premier & Secured Documents (upon request)
There is much to be excited about with the new Intel Partner University experience, including:
A complete upgrade to the digital experience Personalized training pathways And a new content rating system to help partners find and consume the highest peer-rated content.
In addition, we are now providing our partners with curated industry trends and insights, brought to you by the data scientist in the Intel’s Market Sizing and Forecasting team.
Be sure to look forward to a new and improved Intel® Solutions Marketplace user experience:
A new look and feel and easier site navigation An improved experience for generating connections and leads between partners Improved overall search functionality
Intel Partner Alliance is constantly striving to provide more value and benefits so your business can thrive in today's environment. Find out more about what Intel Partner Alliance provides to help you advance your business.
Get started today
Thank you, Your Intel® Partner Alliance team
